newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands reports assays for Frieda.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands reports assays for Frieda.

text.p: Highlands Gold Ltd said on Wednesday it had significant results from drilling at its Frieda River gold and copper prospect in Papua New Guinea.

The results of the four-hole programme carried out within the boundary of the optimised Horse/Ivaal pit showed gold values of up to 0.58 grammes per tonne and copper values of up to 0.76 percent. The drilling was designed to confirm continuity of the mineralisation and to test the western boundary.

"The results of these holes are significant as they demonstrate excellent continuity on a hole to hole basis; report higher assay values for copper and gold than the Horse/Ivaal resource estimate (0.5 percent copper and 0.3 g/t gold reported in September 1996); (and) indicate the presence of additional mineralisation outside the previously defined western resource boundary but inside the Horse/Ivaal pit as designed in the pre-feasibility study," the company said.
